chunk_list: LUMEN TERMINOLOGY GUIDE V1.0 This guide establishes initial bilingual labels and criteria for LUMEN. Every entry contains a source term, preferred label, definition, scope, example, provenance, and status. Identifiers are language independent. A translation difference does not create a new class. Where no direct equivalent exists, the Spanish source term is retained, a functional English label is used, and a note is added. Regional Archive examples take precedence over general dictionaries where they document specific institutional usage. Preferred labels use the singular. Personal names are not translated. Institutional names use an official form where available. Original titles are retained; an access translation is marked and does not replace the source title. Every change is reviewed in both languages. Terminology entry 1 Entry 1: creator. Preferred English label: creator or entity responsible for the fonds. The definition covers responsibility for organic creation of the archival aggregate. The preferred Spanish label is creador o entidad productora del fondo. The identifier is shared across both languages, and variants are added only where they lead to the same concept. The application retains provenance and displays a note where the term may be interpreted differently outside the archival context. The entry remains provisional where a validated example or Regional Archive decision is missing.
